data.title: Growing Number Patterns
data.description: You will answer out loud to explain how number patterns grow.
data.gradeLevel: elementary students (grades 1-5) - Use age-appropriate vocabulary, concrete examples, structured learning objectives, and interactive elements. Build fundamental understanding.

items.conceptStatement: This pattern grows by adding three each time.
items.ask: Three, six, nine, twelve. What is the rule of this pattern?
items.howToPlay: I will show you something, and you tell me what it means in your own words.
items.acceptRule: Any words explaining that three is added each step count as correct.
items.signatureError: Saying the next number, fifteen, is NOT an explanation of the rule.
items.correctionBody: The rule is plus three because the numbers go up by three every time.

actionContract.label: Say Why
actionContract.instruction: Three, six, nine, twelve. What is the rule of this pattern?

items.conceptStatement: This pattern grows by adding four each time.
items.ask: Four, eight, twelve, sixteen. What rule makes this pattern grow?
items.howToPlay: I will show you something, and you tell me what it means in your own words.
items.acceptRule: Any words meaning four is added each time count.
items.signatureError: Repeating the final number, sixteen, is NOT the rule.
items.correctionBody: The rule is plus four because each new number is four more than the last.

actionContract.label: Say Why
actionContract.instruction: Four, eight, twelve, sixteen. What rule makes this pattern grow?

items.conceptStatement: This pattern grows by adding ten each time.
items.ask: Ten, twenty, thirty, forty. What is the rule for this number pattern?
items.howToPlay: I will show you something, and you tell me what it means in your own words.
items.acceptRule: Any phrase explaining that ten is added counts as right.
items.signatureError: Saying the ending number, forty, is NOT an explanation.
items.correctionBody: The rule is plus ten because ten is added at every single step.

actionContract.label: Say Why
actionContract.instruction: Ten, twenty, thirty, forty. What is the rule for this number pattern?

items.conceptStatement: This pattern grows by adding two each time.
items.ask: Two, four, six, eight. How is this pattern growing?
items.howToPlay: I will show you something, and you tell me what it means in your own words.
items.acceptRule: Any explanation mentioning adding two counts.
items.signatureError: Saying the final number, eight, is NOT the rule.
items.correctionBody: The rule is plus two because you increase by two every time.

actionContract.label: Say Why
actionContract.instruction: Two, four, six, eight. How is this pattern growing?

spares.conceptStatement: This pattern grows by adding twenty-five each time.
spares.ask: Twenty-five, fifty, seventy-five, one hundred. What rule governs this pattern?
spares.howToPlay: I will show you something, and you tell me what it means in your own words.
spares.acceptRule: Any statement showing twenty-five is added counts.
spares.signatureError: Saying one hundred is NOT the rule.
spares.correctionBody: The rule is plus twenty-five because twenty-five is added to make each new number.

actionContract.label: Say Why
actionContract.instruction: Twenty-five, fifty, seventy-five, one hundred. What rule governs this pattern?

spares.conceptStatement: This pattern grows by adding five each time.
spares.ask: Five, ten, fifteen, twenty. How does this pattern grow?
spares.howToPlay: I will show you something, and you tell me what it means in your own words.
spares.acceptRule: Any phrasing indicating counting by fives counts as the answer.
spares.signatureError: Saying the last number, twenty, is NOT an explanation.
spares.correctionBody: The rule is plus five because you add five to get the next number.

actionContract.label: Say Why
actionContract.instruction: Five, ten, fifteen, twenty. How does this pattern grow?
